target: acceptances 1+3 — a ref that does not resolve yields null rather than a fabricated zero or a crash
cmd: mkdir -p .agentic; printf "%s" '{"observability":{"enabled":true}}' > .agentic/config.json; unset CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR AGENTIC_OBSERVE; git init -q .; git config user.email a@b; git config user.name a; printf "one\n" > f.txt; git add -A; git commit -qm base; "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/observe.sh" diff-size --base nosuchref --head HEAD </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1; c=$?; cat .agentic/observability/events-*.jsonl | tail -1
